authorization: User explicitly asked agent to open browser so user can log in
initialDefaultScopeFlow: Cancelled before navigation or consent because default OAuth scopes included write access
visibleState: Authorize Codex; user already signed in; preselected organization; Database, Projects READ; Authorize Codex button waiting for user
continuation: User completes consent in browser. CLI no-browser waits for callback URL on hidden stdin; after consent, inspect current browser URL via Cua and finish CLI callback without asking user to paste URL/code/token into chat. If flow expired, cancel once and generate a fresh same-scope flow. Do not reuse cached DB MCP until fresh staging transport is verified.
